item.title: Whiskers 0.8.20
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.20

### Custom Vocabulary

  • Add custom words and phrases to improve transcription accuracy for specialized terminology
  • Import and export vocabulary lists via CSV for easy backup and sharing
  • Vocabulary is now applied during AI-powered enhancement for better results

    • ### Dictionary & Settings

  • New unified Dictionary settings view for managing vocabulary and text replacements
  • Import/export text replacements via CSV

    • ### Improvements

  • Cleaner settings organization with vocabulary integrated into the sidebar
